svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.xylophone-object-plan", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Introduced small wooden-bar struck instrument,top plan. Eight graduated-length bars on two supports. Mallets omitted in this sparse structural view. Named material and pitch order require an external key/real instrument; black outlines do not intrinsically identify wood or tuning.
